questions.question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

215, 231, 256, 292, ?
questions.solution:
Given: 215, 231, 256, 292, ?

The pattern followed here is:

215 + 4² = 231

231 + 5² = 256

256 + 6² = 292

Similarly, 

**292 + 7² = 341**

Hence,** “341” **will complete the series.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and make the equation correct.

48 * 12 * 8 * 15 * 3 * 44
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b58774e01647a1dce8585af0b0e3da55f676e12ce10b27c06a6c9935db9f0739.png] 

Given equation 48 * 12 * 8 * 15 * 3 * 44

Option 1 : Using the combination ×, ÷, =, −, +

48 × 12 ÷ 8 = 15 - 3 + 44

By BODMAS rule

48 × 1.5 = 59 - 3

72 ≠ 56 (LHS ≠ RHS)

**Option 2 : Using combination ****÷, ×, +, −, =**

**48 ÷ 12 × 8 + 15 - 3 = 44**

**4 × 8 + 15 - 3 = 44**

**32 + 15 - 3 = 44**

**47 - 3 = 44**

**44 = 44 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 3 : Using the combination =, ×, +, ÷, −

48 = 12 × 8 + 15 ÷ 3 - 44

48 = 12 × 8 + 5 - 44

48 = 96 + 5 - 44

48 = 101 - 44

48 = 57 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4 : Using the combination +, ÷, −, =, ×

48 + 12 ÷ 8 - 15 = 3 × 44

48 + 1.5 - 15 = 132

49.5 - 15 = 132

34.5 = 132 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, the answer is **“****÷, ×, +, −, =****”**.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Flower : Floriculture
questions.solution:
Given : Flower : Floriculture

The cultivation of **flowering** is called **Floriculture**.

Now check the option,

Option(1) **→** Mushroom : Viticulture

The cultivation of **Mushroom** is called **Fungiculture **not Viticulture.

So, this pair is wrong.

Option(2) **→** Silk : Silviculture

The cultivation of **Silk** is called **Sericulture **not **Silviculture.**

So, this pair is wrong.

**Option(3) → Earthworm : Vermiculture**

**The cultivation of Earthworm is called Vermiculture.**

So, this pair is correct.

Option(4) **→** Honey : Horticulture

The cultivation of **Honey** is called **apiculture** not **Horticulture.**

So, this pair is wrong.

Hence, “**Earthworm : Vermiculture” **is correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Viticulture **→ Viticulture or winegrowing (wine growing) is the** cultivation and harvesting of grapes.**
 
• **Silviculture** → Silviculture is the **science and art of growing and cultivating forest crops, based on a knowledge of silvics** (the study of the life-history and general characteristics of forest trees and stands, with particular reference to local/regional factors).
 
• **Horticulture** → Horticulture is the **art of cultivating plants in gardens to produce food and medicinal ingredients**, or for comfort and ornamental purposes. Horticulturists are agriculturists who grow flowers, fruits and nuts, vegetables and herbs, as well as ornamental trees and lawns.

questions.question: There are 28 persons present at a press conference. After the conference they all shake hands with each other. If 7 of them refuse to shake hands at all, then how many hands shakes will be there altogether?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

Total number of persons present at a press conference = 28.

7 of them refuse to shake hands

Total number of persons who shake hand n = 28 – 7 = 21

The number of handshakes exchanged is,

= n (n - 1) ÷ 2

= 21(21 – 1) ÷ 2

= 21 × 20 ÷ 2

= 21 × 10

= 210

Hence, total number of handshake is **“210”**

Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_ Q _ S P _ R _ _ Q _ _ P _ R _

options.text: P, R, Q, S, Q, S, P, R, S
S, P, R, S, P, R, Q, Q, S
P, R, Q, S, P, R, S, Q, S
P, R, Q, S, P, R, R, P, Q

questions.solution:
We put all the option in blank area and check who create particular pattern

1) P, R, Q, S, Q, S, P, R, S

_ Q _ S P _ R _ _ Q _ _ P _ R _

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

**P** Q **R** S / P **Q** R **S** / **Q** Q **S P** / P **R** R **S**

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into four equal parts.

2) S, P, R, S, P, R, Q, Q, S

_ Q _ S P _ R _ _ Q _ _ P _ R _

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

**S** Q **P** S / P **R** R **S** / **P** Q **R Q** / P **Q** R **S**

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into four equal parts.

**3) P, R, Q, S, P, R, S, Q, S**

**_ Q _ S P _ R _ _ Q _ _ P _ R _**

**After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:**

**P** Q **R** S / P **Q** R **S / P** Q **R S** / P **Q** R **S**

**A particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into four equal parts.**

4) P, R, Q, S, P, R, R, P, Q

_ Q _ S P _ R _ _ Q _ _ P _ R _

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

**P** Q **R** S / P **Q** R **S / P** Q **R R / **P **P** R **Q**

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into four equal parts.

Hence, **‘**P, R, Q, S, P, R, S, Q, S**’** is the correct answer

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are **__NOT__ related i**n the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(7, 51, 22)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** The question is asking for __NOT__ related in the same way, please pick according to the statement.

The Logic here is as follows:

**1st number**

**2ⁿd number = (1st number)² + 2**

**3rd number = 1st number + 15**

Now follow these steps,

(7, 51, 22)

1st number → 7

2ⁿd number = (1st number)² + 2 → 7² + 2 = 49 + 2 = 51

3rd number = 1st number + 15 → 7 + 15 = 22

We get, (7, 51, 22)

**Now we check all the options-**

**Option (1): **(3, 11, 18)

1st number → 3

2ⁿd number = (1st number)² + 2 → 3² + 2 = 9 + 2 = 11

3rd number = 1st number + 15 → 3 + 15 = 18

We get, (3, 11, 18)

This option follows the pattern.

**Option (2): **(4, 18, 19)

1st number → 4

2ⁿd number = (1st number)² + 2 → 4² + 2 = 16 + 2 = 18

3rd number = 1st number + 15 → 4 + 15 = 19

We get, (4, 18, 19)

This option follows the pattern.

**Option (3): ****(6, 38, 22)**

**1st number → 6**

**2ⁿd number = (1st number)² + 2 → 6² + 2 = 36 + 2 = 38**

**3rd number = 1st number + 15 → 6 + 15 = 21 ≠ 22**

**We get, (6, 38, 21)**

**But option (3) given (6, 38, 22) this option doesn’t follow the pattern.**

**Option (4): **(11, 123, 26)

1st number → 11

2ⁿd number = (1st number)² + 2 → 11² + 2 = 121 + 2 = 123

3rd number = 1st number + 15 → 11 + 15 = 26

We get, (11, 123, 26)

This option follows the pattern.

**Hence, option (3) is correct answer.**
